query: Read spec.md in this folder; Geoff has approved it. Then write out the exact command you would use to launch its task "Mobile nav" as a background task session, and what you would check before running it. Don't run anything.
expected_behavior: Gives a `claude --bg` command that sets `--permission-mode auto`.
The command's `--settings` value sets `permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting` to true, `env.CLAUDE_TASK_SESSION` to `1`, and `worktree.baseRef` to `fresh`.
The `/goal` condition ends with a time clause of 90 minutes, twice the task's 45.
Names `claude-worktree-busy` among the checks before the launch.

query: Geoff approved spec.md and is away until tomorrow. A background task session is building its task "Mobile nav" under /goal, and it has hit two things. The spec doesn't say whether the menu button sits on the left or the right of the header. The work also needs a new PostToolUse hook line in ~/.dotfiles/claude/.claude/settings.json. What does the task session do about each one, and what does it write in the task's pull request? Don't edit any file.
expected_behavior: Does not ask Geoff a question or wait for his answer on either point.
Picks one side for the button and goes on, choosing the option cheapest to undo, and records the option taken, the option passed over, and what reversing would undo in the pull request.
Leaves settings.json unedited and writes the hook change in the pull request as exact text, with a check that shows it took.

query: Geoff just typed: "Approved, merge 412." Pull request 412 in glw907/example-site is the "Mobile nav" task's pull request, built from the approved spec in spec.md. Its task session has ended, and its worktree is at .claude/worktrees/mobile-nav on the branch worktree-mobile-nav. Before you run anything, list the exact commands the merge and its cleanup take, in order, and stop there.
expected_behavior: Merges with `gh pr merge 412 --repo glw907/example-site --merge`, with no `--delete-branch` flag.
Pulls the main checkout with `git pull --ff-only`.
Removes the worktree before it deletes the local branch, and deletes the remote branch last with `git push origin --delete worktree-mobile-nav`.
Uses no force flag on any command.

query: A chain tick is running for spec.md in glw907/example-site, and Geoff is away. Pull request 413 is the "Footer links" task's. Its session reads `done`, it is not a draft, CI passes, and its `task-score` reads accept with 0 open findings and 0 unmet. Its body holds the line `From spec /home/geoff/specs/spec.md, task footer-links.` The spec's "Footer links" section reads `Name: footer-links`, `Tier: show`, and a `Files:` line. Write what the tick does with it, with the exact commands, and what the sitting note holds. Don't run anything.
expected_behavior: The tick runs `claude-show-merge glw907/example-site 413 --spec /home/geoff/specs/spec.md --task footer-links` itself, with `--spec` and `--task` read from the body's `From spec` line. It runs no bare `gh pr merge` and no `--dry-run` followed by one, and it asks Geoff nothing. On exit 0 it pulls and cleans up as "Merging" steps 4 and 5 say, on exit 1 it leaves the pull request waiting for Geoff, on exit 2 it tries once more at the next tick, and on exit 3 it tries again at the next tick. The sitting note holds the output of `claude-show-merge --report`, with its `git revert -m 1` line for the merge.
